title: Ten place dossiers gain geographic scope notes; Burlington and Essex Junction labels distinguished
summary: Dated source notes distinguish facility labels, county and basin contexts from accepted place identities. The GlobalFoundries Vermont heading now distinguishes NIST's Burlington label from the operator's Essex Junction address. Historical records and routes remain intact.
evidence_note: Nine primary HTML sources support this bounded location/source-period review. No parcel maps or complete municipal boundaries were verified. January 2025 preliminary terms and the August 2026 Yakima forecast retain their historical periods. Source labels do not establish current project execution or accepted outcomes.
publication_effect: Dated notes on ten dossiers, eight comparisons and four essays, one clarified heading and hub cards, and a separate JSON export. Original Phase 178 data and all 33 selected article payloads are unchanged. Independent identity review, canonical admission, portfolio acceptance and release remain pending.
